name: Credit card
headline: width
subtitle: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 card format
description: Payment cards use the ID-1 size, one of four card sizes defined in the international standard ISO/IEC 7810 for identification cards. An ID-1 card is nominally 85.60 mm wide, 53.98 mm high and 0.76 mm thick. The same standard also defines larger ID-2 and ID-3 sizes for other documents.

measures.label: Width
measures.note: Nominal ID-1 width, stated as 85,60 mm (3.370 in)

facts.text: ISO/IEC 7813, the standard for financial transaction cards, is tested against ID-1 cards.
The larger ID-2 and ID-3 sizes are nominally 105.00 x 74.00 mm and 125.00 x 88.00 mm, with the same 0.76 mm thickness.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 7810:2019 Identification cards - Physical characteristics, clause 3.5
ISO/IEC 7813:2006 Information technology - Identification cards - Financial transaction cards (abstract)

caveats: Values are the nominal ID-1 dimensions; the standard allows small tolerances, which are not listed here, and notes its SI and imperial values are rounded separately.
No official source giving the mass of a card was found, so mass is left out.
